description: A step of the probe pulls the image with no tag and runs on in the same word: `docker pull mcr.microsoft.com/playwright&&docker images` — Docker's `latest`, pulled at whatever it is that morning. The name ends at the `&`, which no list of endings this pattern ever had contained: the version that listed quotes, spaces, `,`, `}` and `]` did not see this mention, and neither would any list a reader could write down. Only a name that ends where it cannot continue reads it.

workflows..github/workflows/e2e-probe.yml:
jobs:
  probe:
    container:
      image: mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.63.0-noble
      options: --user 1001
    steps:
      - run: npx playwright test "$@"
      - run: docker pull mcr.microsoft.com/playwright&&docker images
